Container.Name: Odysseus
Container.Overview:
Odysseus is a self-hosted AI workspace for chat, agents, research, documents, email, notes, calendar, and local model workflows. Works with local models (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) and API providers.
First start: if you leave Admin Password blank, a random password is generated and printed ONCE in this container's log (Docker tab, container log icon). Set your own below to skip that.
Optional companions (separate containers, templates in the same repo): SearXNG enables web search for Deep Research, ChromaDB enables long-term memory, ntfy enables push notifications. Point the variables below at them once installed, e.g. SEARXNG_INSTANCE=http://SERVER_IP:8089 and CHROMADB_HOST=SERVER_IP with CHROMADB_PORT=8100.
Ollama on the same box is reachable at http://host.docker.internal:11434 (the template adds the required host mapping).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Odysseus web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Application data: database, uploads, skills, preferences. Back this up.

Config.Name: SSH Keys
Config.Description: SSH identity used by the Cookbook to manage remote model servers. Odysseus can generate a key here; add its public key to each remote server's authorized_keys.

Config.Name: HuggingFace Cache
Config.Description: Model download cache for Cookbook local models. Can grow large — consider placing it on a share with space.

Config.Name: Local Python Packages
Config.Description: Cookbook-installed serve engines (vLLM, llama-cpp-python, ...). Persisted so a container update does not remove them.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Initial admin account username (used on first start only).

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Initial admin password (min 8 characters, first start only). Leave blank to auto-generate one — it is printed once in the container log.

Config.Name: Ollama / LLM Host
Config.Description: Host where your local model server (e.g. Ollama) runs. 'host.docker.internal' reaches the Unraid host itself; use an IP for another machine.

Config.Name: SearXNG Instance
Config.Description: URL of a SearXNG instance with the JSON format enabled, e.g. http://SERVER_IP:8089. Required for web search / Deep Research. Install the Odysseus-SearXNG companion template or reuse an existing instance.

Config.Name: ChromaDB Host
Config.Description: Host/IP of a ChromaDB server, e.g. your Unraid server IP. Required for long-term memory. Install the Odysseus-ChromaDB companion template.

Config.Name: ChromaDB Port
Config.Description: Port of the ChromaDB server (the companion template maps it to 8100).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as. 99 = 'nobody', the Unraid standard, so files in appdata stay editable.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as. 100 = 'users', the Unraid standard.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Optional API key for OpenAI-compatible providers. All keys can also be configured later in the web UI.

Config.Name: HuggingFace Token
Config.Description: Optional HuggingFace token for gated model downloads in the Cookbook.

Config.Name: Auth Enabled
Config.Description: Keep 'true' unless Odysseus is only reachable from a fully trusted network.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated CORS origins. Only needed if a separate frontend or reverse-proxied origin calls the API cross-origin; the built-in web UI is same-origin and needs no change.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to 'true' when serving Odysseus over HTTPS (e.g. behind a reverse proxy with TLS).
